'''2006 Dantooine Regional''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG regional championship held on Saturday 10 June 2006 at Enigmas Collectibles & Games, 10801 Spring Cypress Road, Suite 6, Houston, Texas, with [[Nick Reisch]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-10157-139725">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=139725#139725 Dantooine Regionals June 10], Nick Reisch (aeneas23), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618002138/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141541 Internet Archive]</ref> Twelve players took part. [[Bobby Hilburn]] and [[JW Millet]] finished in the top two and took the byes to the [[2006 World Championship|World Championship]]; they did not play a final confrontation and split the prize money.<ref name="pcf-10157-141541">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141541#141541 Dantooine Regionals June 10], Nick Reisch (aeneas23), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618002138/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141541 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Enigmas Collectibles & Games, 10801 Spring Cypress Road, Suite 6, Houston, Texas<ref name="pcf-10157-139725" />
* '''Dates:''' 10 June 2006<ref name="pcf-10157-139725" />
* '''Time:''' signup from 11 am; start 12:30<ref name="pcf-10157-139725" />
* '''Format:''' six games and a final confrontation, with semi-finals if 18 or more players came; decklists required; no clear sleeves<ref name="pcf-10157-139725" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="pcf-10157-139725" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Nick Reisch]]<ref name="pcf-10157-139725" />

== Results ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Place !! Player !! Points (differential) !! Decks
|-
| Top two || [[Bobby Hilburn]] || 10 (+121) || TIGIH racing; CR (V) Hoth Walkers
|-
| Top two || [[JW Millet]] || 8 (the differential is cut off in the post) || TIGIH racing; CR (V) Hoth Walkers
|}

Hilburn and Millet came together from Stephenville and had already played each other on both sides, so they split the prize money instead of playing the final confrontation. Both played the same decks with a few different card choices. [[Thomas Whaley]] went undefeated with an ISB deck, first designed by [[Kevin Elia]] and modified by Reisch, but his Light Side deck kept him out of the top two.<ref name="pcf-10157-141541" />

The most played decks were TIGIH (three players), CR (V) Hoth Walkers, Super draining Tuskens, CR (V) Tatooine mains and HB with matching pilots (two each); every other deck was played by one player.<ref name="pcf-10157-141541" />
